slides.headline: 3 things AI should *never send* without your yes
slides.sub: We run on 100+ AI employees. These 3 still wait for a person.

slides.title: Refunds
slides.body: Money out is final. The AI gathers the order, the reason and the amount. A person clicks pay.
slides.cost: Rule: AI prepares, a person pays

slides.title: Customer emails
slides.body: Routine answers can go alone once you trust them. A promise, a discount or an apology waits for a person.
slides.cost: Rule: AI drafts, your team sends the hard ones

slides.title: Freight bookings
slides.body: A booking commits a truck and a bill. The AI compares carriers and prices. A person confirms.
slides.cost: Rule: AI shortlists, a person books

slides.title: This month, the big names *agreed*
